searchText: I won't be able to make the meeting this morning, I'm waiting right now for our group to implement the EIP Bot before I can continue its integration / bug fixes. I also discussed being a `part time Micah support engineer` which would just be to allow me to support micah in moving some of the existing workflows to github actions.
